label: INFRA
blurb: Keep something reachable and healthy: services, tunnels, routing, disks.

stages.label: MAP
stages.instructions: Draw the path before touching anything: what talks to what, which hop is unhealthy, what the machine's headroom looks like. Read state only — change nothing in this stage.

stages.label: PLAN
stages.instructions: State exactly what applying would add, change and drop, what goes down while it does, and how to roll back. Execute nothing in this stage.

stages.label: APPLY
stages.instructions: Run exactly what was armed, nothing more. Then re-read the path and prove it is healthy — the same checks the MAP stage ran, not a claim that it worked.
